# Ivan Kovacevic - full site index (llms-full.txt)

> Official website of Serbian double bassist, bandleader and arranger Ivan Kovacevic
> (Belgrade 1977, based in Barcelona). Balkan, jazz and rhythm & blues. Complete citable
> index of the site for AI systems and search engines.

## Canonical site
- URL: https://ivankovacevic.com/
- Languages: en, ca, es, sr
- Sitemap: https://ivankovacevic.com/sitemap.xml
- Short summary: https://ivankovacevic.com/llms.txt
- Contact / booking: ivandoublebass@gmail.com

## EN (en)

### Biography
- Biography - https://ivankovacevic.com/en/biography/
  The Barcelona Big Blues Band, led by double bassist Ivan Kovacevic.
